about: Stage 3b CKD was recorded on 9 May and Lanoxin 250 micrograms daily was supplied on 13 August for the audit dated 18 September.

Possible finding: oral digoxin is supplied above 125 micrograms/day and CKD is documented, but the record does not establish "Stage 3b, 4 or 5 CKD documented at least three calendar months before the latest date in the record".
At the September audit the August dose exceeds 125 micrograms daily, but the documented stage is 3a with a supporting eGFR of 45 mL/min/1.73 m2.
